title: Datadew Valley

sections.heading: About the project
sections.text:
PLACEHOLDER: Datadew Valley is a research project at Brown University about what it is like to live next to a data center. It invites people who use AI tools every day to spend a few minutes in the shoes of a community that hosts the infrastructure behind them.

PLACEHOLDER: A second paragraph about the study, the team's goals, and how the simulation was made.
